A vertical cross-section of soil showing five distinct layers. From top to bottom: O horizon (a thin dark layer of decomposing leaves and organic matter), A horizon (dark topsoil with plant roots), B horizon (lighter brown subsoil with clay accumulation), C horizon (weathered rock fragments), and D/R horizon (solid grey bedrock). Labels on the left for each horizon: O, A, B, C, D/R. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
